help_stdout:
Usage: scm_estimator --data FILE [options]
  --method full|tangent|hybrid   Observation representation (default full)
  --modes 1|2|3                 Foster branches (default 3)
  --starts N                    Nonlinear starts
  --max-iter N                  Iteration limit per start
  --sigma VALUE                 Known iid voltage sigma in V
  --case ID                     JSON identifier
  --prefix N                    Read only the first N observations
  --initial a,b,...             Exactly modes+4 transformed theta values
  --fixed INDEX VALUE           Fix transformed theta; repeatable
  --fixed-alpha INDEX VALUE     Fix physical linear coordinate; repeatable
  --fixed-current-soc VALUE     Fix SOC at the end of the retained prefix
  --ocv FILE                    Known PWL table with header z,voltage
  --help                        This help
Data header: sample_index,dt_s,current_A,voltage_V
Indices start at0 and remain contiguous. Point voltage is at interval END.
theta=log(tau_i),log(gamma_plus),log(gamma_minus),z0,log(Q_Ah).
alpha=R0,R_i,H,v_i0,u0=H*h0. Fixed current SOC couples z0 to Q and charge.
Joint-normal diagnostics describe likelihood linearization before damping, not a posterior.
Default OCV is illustrative, not measured:3+1.15*z+.08*tanh(8*(z-.5)).
Host reference replays retained data; no bounded-memory online claim.
